sources.title: Ronald de Wolf, Quantum Computing: Lecture Notes, arXiv:1907.09415v6
sources.locator: Chapter 5, §§5.1–5.2, period finding and factoring, PDF pp. 49–56.

contents.name: alg-qa-shor-factoring
contents.support: Both treatments give the residue-gcd, period-finding and half-power factor-recovery route; this carrier makes the retry cap, exact checks and failure target explicit.

contents.name: lem-qa-shor-perfect-power-precheck
contents.support: The factorization treatments motivate the even/perfect-power prechecks; integer-root search bounds and exact verification are proved locally.

contents.name: lem-qa-shor-residue-gcd-branch
contents.support: The source route uses a random residue and immediate gcd branch. de Wolf samples from 2,…,N−1; this batch uses 1,…,N−1 and proves the conditional unit law including a=1 locally.

contents.name: lem-qa-even-order-square-root
contents.support: Both treatments use the half-period square-root-of-one reduction; the output-validity statement for nonminimal checked periods is proved locally.

contents.name: lem-qa-crt-sign-vector-factorization
contents.support: The source gives the CRT sign-vector route; the local proof establishes the only two roots modulo each odd prime power and proves both gcd bounds in full.

contents.name: lem-qa-prime-power-order-two-adic-law
contents.support: The source gives the order-reduction probability route; the exact local valuation distribution and count are proved in this item.

contents.name: thm-qa-order-to-factor-correctness
contents.support: The papers use the checked half-power gcd reduction; this item proves output correctness conditional on the exact checks, without a minimal-order premise.

contents.name: thm-qa-order-to-factor-success
contents.support: The source supplies the classical CRT reduction argument; this item proves the finite component-order valuation bound and its exact probability estimate.

contents.name: thm-qa-shor-factoring-success
contents.support: The sources give the bounded-error composition route; the pointwise 3/4 order guarantee is combined with the true-order event without assuming those events are independent.

contents.name: thm-qa-shor-factoring-cost
contents.support: The source discusses polynomial factoring costs; separate ideal QFT, explicit multiplier, oracle-query and binary bit-operation branches are proved locally and cross-checked against current QA08 cost carriers.

contents.name: def-qa-shor-cost-accounting
contents.support: The papers motivate arithmetic, QFT and query costs; this exact-angle/mixed-cost convention is an explicit local definition.

contents.name: alg-qa-shor-uniform-residue-sampler
contents.support: Both papers use a uniformly random residue as an algorithmic primitive; this exact fair-bit rejection implementation is supplied locally.

contents.name: thm-qa-shor-residue-sampler-correct-and-cost
contents.support: The papers assume uniform random residues; exact uniformity, almost-sure termination and expected sampler bit costs are proved locally.
